thread:
Kaitlyn: Quick sync 3 final checklist for tomorrow's release. Need: changelog link, docs push link, canary timing, bench blurbs for the launch post, webinar CTA copy, and inbound lead routing plan. Who's owning what?
Devon: I can take changelog + docs link. Will push final changelog to the repo and post link here in ~20m.
Priya: I'll own webinar CTA and landing page copy. Can someone add the canonical docs URL once Devon has it so I can wire the CTA?
Marco: I'll handle rollout timing + canary schedule. Plan: canary start 09:00 PT, 30m monitor, 50% at 09:45, 100% at 10:30. Fallback to v1 if errors >3%. Oncall chain = eng-oncall -> Marco -> Devon.
Kaitlyn: For bench narrative: two short callouts 3 median latency improvement and cost/unit reduction. Keep numbers rounded for public copy.
Devon: changelog draft uploaded: https://git.company/repo/releases/1791234/changelog.md (WIP)
Devon: docs PR: https://docs.company/pull/812 3 will merge after quick review.
Priya: Draft CTA: "Join our launch webinar 3 see how up to 2x throughput and ~30% lower per-token cost make it easier to ship at scale." Thoughts?
Marco: Sounds good. Recommend "up to 2x" unless bench team signs off.
Kaitlyn: Agreed. @Devon please tag bench owners. Also add canary timing to changelog.
Devon: Bench leads tagged in PR comments. Added canary/fallback note in changelog.
CI-bot: Build 1791234/docs passed  
 3 docs PR ready for merge after reviewers.
Priya: Webinar logistics 3 45m slot. Need a before/after perf slide, 30s demo, 10-15m Q&A. Who runs demo?
Marco: I'll run demo with telemetry. Need 1-liner for security/compliance for Private customers.
Kaitlyn: I'll draft the security one-liner and two tweet-length headlines.
Devon: Docs PR merged. Final docs link: https://docs.company/release/1791234 3 use for CTA and changelog.
Priya: CTA updated and landing page wired.
Marco: Canary schedule added to ops playbook. Will paste snippet here EOD.
Kaitlyn: Inbound lead routing: webhook from webinar signup -> HubSpot list "Launch 1791234" -> SDR triage. @Priya add hidden utm=launch_1791234 on form?
Priya: Yep, creating form. Webhook: https://hooks.hubspot.com/forms/1791234
Devon: Changelog short bullet for release post: "Reduced median token latency by up to 25% and introduced routing policy that reduces serving cost by ~30% on chat workloads." Thoughts?
Marco: OK as long as bench confirms. Keep policy blurb high-level.
Kaitlyn: Bench leads approved: latency 22% median improvement, cost reduction 28% typical. We'll round to "up to 2x" throughput and "~30%" cost in marketing.
Priya: Landing page and webinar invite updated with final links and numbers.
CI-bot: Deploy window reserved 09:00 PT  status: approved by release-coordinator.
Kaitlyn: Please lock final copy by 16:30 PT. Pre-launch 15m check at 08:30 PT in #release-war-room.
Devon: Added code snippet to docs showing new client config for canary fallback:
Devon: ```json
{"routingPolicy":"canary","fallback":"v1","canaryWindow":1800}
```
Marco: Playbook snippet: incident callbacks confirmed. Pasting in release-war-room channel.
Priya: All set from my side, staging landing page live.
Kaitlyn: Thanks everyone 3 will ping for the prelaunch check. :rocket:
